name: Mug Shot!
summary:
Mug Shot! is a roguelite deckbuilder set in a small travelling café. Each shift is a turn-based card puzzle in which the player pulls espresso shots, steams milk and pours latte art to complete customer orders before the queue runs out of patience; the café only advances when the player ends the round, so there are no reaction timers.

Between shifts the player chooses a route across each venue's map, drafts new cards, buys equipment and hires crew before facing a critic at the end of the week. Runs feed a longer story about saving the businesses of Maple Street from a coffee chain, and a hub, Carmen's Snug, is gradually restored between runs.
